args.claim_summary: Fathom (u_4812) hit a SyncTimeoutError spike (31 events) on 2026-09-03, which coincides exactly with a confirmed SEV-2 Datadog incident "Sync jobs timing out" in their region (us-east-1, 09:10-14:40 UTC that day). Mixpanel shows sync is 82% of the team's product usage and 4 teammates were active that day, so this was a core-feature outage hitting an engaged team, and the customer cancelled ~10 days later. The fix (v4.12) landed 2026-09-05, resolving the issue, but the cancellation came after the incident despite the fix.
